title: Book 6 — Erato, Chapter 26
paragraphs: So it came to pass regarding these matters; and meanwhile Histiaeus the Milesian, who was at Byzantium seizing the Ionian merchant vessels as they sailed out of the Pontus, received the report of what had happened concerning Miletus. Upon this he entrusted affairs pertaining to the Hellespont to Bisaltes son of Apollophanes, a man of Abydos, while he himself with the Lesbians sailed to Chios. When a body of Chians on guard would not let him approach, he fought them at the spot in Chian territory called the “Hollows.” Histiaeus not only killed many of these, but, taking Polichne of the Chians as his base, he subdued the remainder of the Chians too with the Lesbians' help, since they had suffered great loss in the sea-fight.
